related.title: How Trump’s latest tariff moves hand India an edge over rival Asian exporters
related.summary: Proposed tariffs of 18% on Bangladesh, Cambodia, Thailand, and 20% on China and Vietnam, subject to their respective trade deals, offer India a competitive advantage.

related.title: Brazil blasts ‘unacceptable’ new US tariff proposals
related.summary: President Lula’s office says Brazil will not yield to threats and aims for a negotiated resolution.

related.title: US Tariff Plan Raises Stakes for India to Clinch Trade Deal
related.summary: The US plans to impose a 17% tariff on Indian goods, lower than regional peers like Vietnam, Malaysia and Bangladesh. The rate would be hiked to 25% if the country fails to secure a deal, according to a statement from the US Trade Representative. This puts pressure on India to agree to a trade deal or face a higher levy, leaving exporters and investors with little clarity on the trade outlook. (Source: Bloomberg)

0730406699.topic: Trump annuncia nuovi dazi contro UE, Cina e altri 12 Paesi
0730406699.reason: La nuova ondata di dazi USA colpisce anche l'UE e quindi l'export italiano. La notizia è ripresa da più testate autorevoli e ha già provocato reazioni internazionali, come quella del Brasile.
